_comment: Shared by explorer.html and the Python API. thresholds: folder -> {label: shown in the threshold selector; the folder is a subfolder of thresholds/ holding matrix.csv (tract x topic decoding, joint LPI + RAS), matrix_RAS.csv / matrix_LPI.csv (each endpoint on its own), cluster-matrix.csv (cluster x topic) and func/ (per-tract endpoint maps '{lh|rh}.{tract}.{LPI|RAS}.func.gii'); func: another threshold whose func/ maps this one reuses; cut: dendrogram distance cut for live clustering; noClusters: true hides the Cluster step; value: numeric threshold}. defaultThreshold: a folder. Labels show complete tracts in the dendrogram / map-complete cohort size. The rest of data/ is laid out as in data/README.md.
